content.hook_text: Read this if you feel like you're not enough
content.verse_text: But he said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness." Therefore I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ's power may rest on me.
content.reflection: Paul begged God to remove his weakness. God said no — because it's precisely in our inadequacy that His power shines brightest. Your weakness isn't a flaw to hide. It's a stage for grace.
